clips.title: The story
paras: Having brought Kravel Koalbeard's parts order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig, you now carry Kravel's package back to him at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats. Dizzywig sends a message along with it: if Kravel wants more special orders, he will have to pay his tab.

Wharfmaster Dizzywig gives you a package meant for Kravel Koalbeard, who waits at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles. Dizzywig asks you to pass on a warning with it: if Kravel hopes for more special orders, he must first pay what he owes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here's Kravel's package, friend. And when you deliver it, tell him... If he wants more special orders, then he'll have to pay his tab!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you make it to Ratchet and get those parts?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you got them! Now we need to get them to the gnomes. But first...
Let's take out one small item...
